description_en: Queries the policy-based routes configured for a VPN gateway instance by calling the DescribeVpnPbrRouteEntries operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnPbrRouteEntries接口查询VPN网关实例下配置的策略路由的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-pbr-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1a3kqjiiq9legfx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnPbrRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list

items.description_en: The information about the policy-based route

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the policy-based route was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in the UNIX format and represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建策略路由的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建策略路由时的总时长

NextHop.description_en: The next hop of the policy-based route

NextHopTunnelId.description_en:
The tunnel ID associated with the next hop of the policy-based route.

This parameter is returned only for VPN gateway instances that support dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
NextHopTunnelId.description_zh:
策略路由下一跳关联的隧道ID。

仅支持双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回当前参数

Priority.description_en:
The policy priority of the policy-based route.

A smaller value indicates a higher priority for the policy-based route
Priority.description_zh:
策略路由的策略优先级。

策略优先级数字越小，策略路由的优先级越高

RouteDest.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the policy-based route

RouteSource.description_en: The source CIDR block of the policy-based route

State.description_en:
The publish status of the policy-based route.

published: The policy-based route is published to the route table of the VPC.

normal: The policy-based route is not published to the route table of the VPC
State.description_zh:
策略路由的发布状态。

published：已发布策略路由到VPC的路由表。

normal：未发布策略路由到VPC的路由表

VpnInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the policy-based route.

For VPN gateway instances that support single-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, the weight value represents the priority of the policy-based route:

100: High priority. If multiple policy-based routes with the same source and destination CIDR blocks exist, the IPsec-VPN connection associated with this policy-based route serves as the active link.
0: Low priority. If multiple policy-based routes with the same source and destination CIDR blocks exist, the IPsec-VPN connection associated with this policy-based route serves as the standby link.

For VPN gateway instances that support dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, this parameter does not take effect
Weight.description_zh:
策略路由的权重值。

对于支持IPsec-VPN连接单隧道模式的VPN网关实例，策略路由权重值代表策略路由的优先级：

100：表示高优先级。存在源网段、目标网段均相同的多条策略路由时，该策略路由关联的IPsec连接为主链路。
0：表示低优先级。存在源网段、目标网段均相同的多条策略路由时，该策略路由关联的IPsec连接为备链路。

对于支持IPsec-VPN连接双隧道模式的VPN网关实例，当前参数不生效
